common_nature_required: Add a nature to the document first.
common_analytics_intro: Sequit uses PostHog to understand how the editor is used and to fix bugs. The content of your documents (text, titles, inputs) is never sent.
common_analytics_consent: Permission to store a random identifier in this browser, to recognize your next visits. Without your consent, your visits are not linked to each other.
common_analytics_always_heading: Always active, without a stored identifier
common_analytics_always: Counts of page views and editor actions (creating boxes, links, groups, natures…), technical errors and session recordings in which all text is masked.
common_analytics_choice_accepted: Your current choice: visit identifier accepted.
common_analytics_choice_refused: Your current choice: visit identifier refused.
